From: Anna Lee <anna@blueatlas.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood trial + demo

Hi Priyom,

We just signed up for the self-serve trial and I wanted to reach out to see if someone could do a quick 30-minute demo to walk through how Redwood would fit into our recommendations pipeline. High-level: we’re BlueAtlas (e‑commerce), building personalized product recs in-app.

Some quick context:
- Expected peak concurrency: ~300 req/s during flash promotions
- Typical prompt size: ~20–60 tokens; we do additional metadata lookups per request
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in August, production by January

Can we schedule a short demo next week? Happy to share traffic screenshots — attaching one now.

Thanks,
Anna Lee
Head of Product
BlueAtlas, Inc.
(attachment: traffic-screenshot.png)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood trial + demo

Hi Anna — thanks for signing up and for the context. I’m Priyom on the SDR team. Quick follow-ups so we scope the demo properly and set the right folks:

- Is the 300 req/s peak from a single region or globally distributed?
- Are model responses sensitive (PII) or subject to special retention limits?
- Do you expect most calls to be single-turn generation, or multi-turn chat-style?
- Would you prefer a product-focused demo (integration + observability) or a technical deep-dive with a Solutions Engineer?

If you’re available for a 30-min session, I can bring Laura (our Solutions Engineer) to talk about batching/kv cache and a quick throughput sketch. Suggested slots (PT):
- Wed Jul 7, 9:30–10:00am PT
- Thu Jul 8, 11:00–11:30am PT

If those don’t work, reply with 2–3 times that work for you and we’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a short pilot intake template to make it easy to share more detail if you want.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
(attachment: pilot-intake-template.pdf)

Thanks, Priyom — quick answers inline.

- Region: traffic is primarily US-east but we have customers in EU; for the flash promotions the bulk is US-east.
- Data sensitivity: product interaction data only; no customer PII in prompts. We do store identifiers separately and can redact as needed.
- Call pattern: single-turn generation for rec ranking, plus a small percentage (5–10%) of multi-turn for follow-ups.
- Demo preference: product-focused with a short technical segment — want to understand integration effort and latency implications.

We can do next week mornings EST (Tue/Wed/Thu). If you can share a couple of slots in EST that would be ideal. I’ve re-attached the traffic screenshot for reference.

Anna
